chords._schema: strings ordered low E (6) to high e (1). frets: null = muted/not played, 0 = open. fingers: 0 = open, 1 = index, 2 = middle, 3 = ring, 4 = pinky, null = muted.

exercises.name: Read the box

params.rule: vertical lines = strings (left = low E), horizontal = frets, dots = where to press, numbers = fingers
params.cue: the app draws these from the lesson data — identical to what you play

exercises.coaching: A chord box is a tiny fretboard: vertical lines are strings (left is low E), horizontal are frets, dots are where your fingers go, numbers are which finger. The app draws these from the exact data you play — no guessing.

exercises.name: Read TAB
exercises.purpose: Map numbers to fret numbers per string.

params.rule: six lines = strings (top = high e), numbers = fret to press on that string, 0 = open
params.cue: read left to right, one column at a time

exercises.coaching: TAB is six lines (top is high e). A number tells you the fret on that string; 0 means open. Read left to right, one column at a time. Melodies, not just chords.

exercises.name: Play one new chart
exercises.purpose: Apply it to a library song.

params.cue: read the chart, play the loop

exercises.coaching: Open a simple chart from the library — exercise-only, safe per licensing. Read the boxes, play the loop. You just taught yourself a song. That is the self-serve superpower.

avatar_coaching_copy.intro: The goal was always independence: you reading a chart and learning a song yourself. Today we decode chord boxes and TAB.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex1_intro: A chord box is a mini fretboard — left line is low E, dots are fingers, numbers are which finger. The app draws these from your lesson data, so what you see is what you play.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex2_intro: TAB: six lines, top is high e, numbers are frets, 0 is open. Read left to right. Now you can follow melodies, not just chords.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex3_intro: Grab a simple library chart — exercise-only, licensing-safe. Read it, play the loop. You taught yourself a song. That is the point of all this.
avatar_coaching_copy.results: If you can read a box and a TAB line, no song at your level is off-limits. You are self-sufficient.
avatar_coaching_copy.wrap: Chart-reading done. Lesson 20: capstone — play a full song and set your habit plan.
